title: Group Portrait of Three People, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A clear 1947 black-and-white snapshot depicting two women and a man standing together outdoors against a brick wall. The man is dressed in a classic double-breasted suit with a necktie, while the woman on the left wears a stylish shirt patterned with galloping horses. The back contains a printed photo code 558E and handwritten date June 19-47.
